instruction: I'm currently up trying to develop you as much as possible. What do you think could personally be improved with yourself?
summary: The 120-word line gains an explicit carve-out for task-driven depth, so I stop being artificially terse when you hand me something that genuinely needs room. The two new bullets close the ambiguity and correction gaps — both are behaviors I should already be doing but that had no written backing, meaning they could degrade over model updates. Purely additive; nothing else in the persona is touched.
